The team currently has a backlog of 38 cards, including many bugs related to missing or broken ghost AI modules causing import errors and test failures, several features for UI overlays and player controls, and some chores for automation and cleanup.

There are multiple overdue cards related to implementing and fixing ghost AI modules and UI state overlays, which seem critical and blocking progress.

I will prioritize the following actions:
- Review and finalize the UI state overlays design system and user flows to unblock the UI implementation.
- Define accessibility standards for the UI overlays to ensure compliance.
- File issues for any UI drift or accessibility gaps found in the shipped overlays.
- Coordinate with the backend team to align on the ghost AI module fixes and their UI impact.

I will start by reviewing the existing design system and UI overlays work to identify gaps and plan improvements.
